# Welcome to TwitchyButt CMS discussions

TwitchyButt CMS is self-hosted, content-neutral creator software. The application is a **development preview, not an approved production release**.

Use **Q&A** for setup and usage questions, **Ideas** for feature exploration, **General** for community conversation, and **Show and tell** for public-safe development examples. **Announcements** contains maintainer updates; an announcement alone is not release approval. Mark a Q&A answer when it resolves your question.

For reproducible defects or documentation corrections, use the [issue forms](https://github.com/paulkakell/twitchybutt/issues/new/choose). Accepted feature proposals belong in the [roadmap](https://github.com/paulkakell/twitchybutt/blob/main/ROADMAP.md), with stable TB identifiers and observable acceptance criteria. The editable planning Sheet and repository snapshot are not automatically synchronized.

Keep discussions respectful, on topic and content-neutral. Do not post harassment, spam, personal information, credentials, wallet keys, identity records, private media or unredacted logs. Use synthetic examples. Moderators may edit, move, close or remove unsafe/off-topic posts.

**Never disclose suspected vulnerabilities here.** Follow the [security policy](https://github.com/paulkakell/twitchybutt/security/policy). If private reporting is unavailable, request a private channel without including exploit details.

All unresolved findings above Low, unknown severity and incomplete required reviews remain release blockers. Dependency automation does not authorize merges, deployments, production payments or restricted publication.

Project sponsorship is voluntary and separate from the proposed licensing/payment model. A donation does not buy roadmap priority, security exceptions, a commercial license or a production-readiness guarantee. See [contributing guidance](https://github.com/paulkakell/twitchybutt/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
